name: authelia
description_en: The Single Sign-On Multi-Factor portal for web apps, now OpenID Certified™
readme_excerpt: [ ][Apache 2.0] Authelia is an open-source authentication and authorization server providing two-factor authentication and single sign-on (SSO) for your applications via a web portal. It acts as a companion for reverse proxies by allowing, denying, or redirecting requests. Documentation is available at https://www.authelia.com/.
